program_dir=base/'programs'; program_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(row) for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg)
    marker=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # The marker color forms the repeated isolated points; the connected
    # non-background component is the stencil.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if g[r][c]==bg or g[r][c]==marker or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]!=bg and g[yy][xx]!=marker:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp)
    c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
    motif=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    ar,ac=len(motif)//2,len(motif[0])//2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    points=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==marker]
    for r,c in points:
      for i in range(len(motif)):
        for j in range(len(motif[0])):
          v=motif[i][j]
          y,x=r+i-ar,c+j-ac
          if v!=bg and 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w:
            out[y][x]=v
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
